lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Sparse grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. Primary visible row contains approximately 5-6 distinct centroids spaced roughly equidistant below the mid-lateral carina.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance visible as faint pillars intersecting horizontal spot rows, creating a rectangular grid-like pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally across the flank. The uppermost ridge exhibits a strong luminance gradient with a sharp highlight on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of faint, small high-luminance blobs concentrated near the anterior margin and basal region of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible patterning on the pectoral fin surface consisting of small, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots.
